dedupe_keys.name: great lakes white nile basin elevations and benchmarks

description: Hamilton and colleagues publish lake elevations and survey benchmarks for the Great Lakes of the White Nile basin in a third Harvard Dataverse deposit. The own repository is CC0 1.0 and makes an all-lakes surface-depth table plus per-lake ZIP survey files available. Coverage is four Great Lakes of the White Nile basin. These height references can anchor bathymetry and shoreline inputs in hydraulic or storage-capacity simulations. A caveat is that mixing elevation sources without their vertical datum can shift inferred depths and lake volumes; the user must keep the benchmark and datum metadata attached. This DOI does not contain the separate sounding rasters or shoreline polygons, which have their own records. The article explains a combined lake mapping workflow, but the deposited elevation file inventory is the evidence for this resource. I read the own Dataverse metadata, rights and article Data Records without downloading archives, verifying benchmark coordinates or recomputing water levels. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
